shared.noConversation: No active session. Need conversation ID.
shared.dynamicToolActivationDisabled: Dynamic tool switching disabled. Admin can enable in Settings.
shared.invalidToolsArray: 'tools' must be non-empty list of tool name or domain prefix.
shared.searchActionNudgeDisabled: IMPORTANT: some found tool NOT enabled (isEnabled: false). MUST call enable_tools with tool name before use. After enabling, ready next turn.

enable_tools.noValidTools: No requested name matched any tool. Check spelling or use search_tools.
enable_tools.alreadyEnabled: All requested tool already enabled — use now.

disable_tools.noneInSet: No requested tool in active set.

discover_and_enable_tools.foundAndEnabled: Found {{matchCount}} tool, auto-enabled {{enabledCount}}. Ready next turn.
discover_and_enable_tools.foundAlreadyEnabled: Found {{matchCount}} tool, all already enabled — use now.

set_timer.invalidDuration: 'durationSeconds' must be {{min}}-{{max}}. For longer or recurring, use create_cron_job.

enter_worktree.noConversation: No session — worktree requires active session.
enter_worktree.alreadyInWorktree: Already in worktree (branch: {{branch}}). Call exit_worktree first.
enter_worktree.success: Entered worktree. File operation redirected to {{path}}. Call exit_worktree with 'merge' or 'discard' when done.

exit_worktree.notInWorktree: Not in worktree. Call enter_worktree first.
exit_worktree.mergeFailed: Merge failed: {{error}}. Worktree preserved at {{path}}. Resolve conflict and retry, or exit_worktree with 'discard'.
exit_worktree.merged: Change from {{branch}} merged to main. Workspace restored.
exit_worktree.discarded: Worktree {{branch}} discarded. All change dropped. Workspace restored.

search_conversations.noEmbeddings: No session with embedding found. Session get embedded after agent conversation with 6+ message.

ask_user.questionsRequired: 'questions' list required, must not be empty.
ask_user.invalidQuestion: Each question must have non-empty 'question' string.
ask_user.noConversation: No session — ask_user requires active session.

write_todo.invalidItems: 'items' must be list of todo item.
